updates.text: Liverpool raised its Express gate rate from £6 to £7 for up to 10 minutes — its second rise in a year (£5 in 2025). The longer tiers (£10/20 min, £25/hour) are unchanged.
Full verification sweep of all 29 airports: drop-off zone locations, payment methods and deadlines, pick-up rules and Blue Badge arrangements checked against each airport's own pages.

East Midlands corrected: the Rapid Drop Off is £5 for up to 15 minutes (we previously showed £6 for 30 minutes, a figure that belonged to Short Stay 1). The airport's page also confirms the lanes are drop-off only.
Liverpool's Express gate rate confirmed at £6 for 10 minutes — up from £5 in 2025. The rise is now in our fee-history table.
Southend updated: the Express area is barrierless ANPR paid online by midnight the following day, and the airport has withdrawn its free drop-off option entirely.
Cardiff raised its drop-off charge from £3 to £4.50 for 10 minutes (and £4.50 per additional 10 minutes) — up 50%.
Stansted's Express Set Down changed to £10 for up to 15 minutes and £28 for over 15 minutes.
Belfast International raised its drop-off charge from £3 to £5 for 10 minutes — a 66% rise, the largest recorded in our index.
London City introduced a drop-off charge for the first time: £8 for up to 5 minutes, £1 per additional minute to a 10-minute maximum, ANPR-enforced and paid online.
